caveats.en: Not playable on RTX Spark yet: the developer has not finished its side of Arm anti-cheat support. KRAFTON intends to bring it to the platform by the first half of 2027.
caveats.zh-TW: 目前在 RTX Spark 上還不能玩：開發商尚未完成 Arm 版反作弊的整合。KRAFTON 預計在 2027 年上半年前讓它支援這個平台。
